newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara has no comment on Monday's forex moves.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara has no comment on Monday's forex moves.

text.p: Senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Monday he would make no comment on Monday's exchange rate movements.

On returning to Tokyo from the southern Japan city of Fukuoka, where he attended a meeting of the Asian Development Bank, he was asked how he viewed Monday's fall in the dollar below 118 yen and if the yen's sharp rise since last week has been excessive or too rapid.
"I don't make any comments on questions about exchange rates," he told reporters.
Earlier on Monday, Sakakibara told reporters in Fukuoka, where he was attending a conference of the Asian Development Bank, that the dollar was "likely to settle down soon".
His comments helped the U.S. currency stabilise after it tumbled below 118 yen in early Asian trade on Monday to its lowest point in nearly four months.
